description: Historical Clean Air Score, grade, latest annual PM2.5 mean, unhealthy-day share, trend and yearly PM2.5 for one US city. Each city is either an own_record (scored from its own data) or a copied_record (the full record of the nearest scored city, named in source_city, source_state and source_distance_miles). A copied_record describes the source city, not measurements taken in the named city. Values are historical annual data, not the current AQI.
name: get_city_air_quality
title: Get city air quality record
